parsed.explanation: c and e are introduced symmetrically as two arbitrary positive values of d, so the labels are interchangeable; 'swap the roles of c and e' is exactly the legitimate WLOG (re-apply (4) with x on the e-orbit, y on the c-orbit), and the write-up states that swap explicitly. Checking Case 1: with n=qk, m=pk and cq=ep the quadratic term vanishes and the k-coefficient is 2c(x0-y0)*0 + 2c^2 q + 2cep - 4ceq = 4cq(c-e), negative when c<e, giving the contradiction; after the swap the coefficient is 4e q'(e-c)<0 when c>e. The parenthetical gloss is loose but its content (swapping x,y swaps c,e and flips the linear sign) is accurate, so no gap remains.
